semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity. B8TCAE adds14 minimized public UTF8 input/flag cases to the existing native-edge callback corpus: unclosed/escaped link destinations and labels, terminal angle prefixes, table delimiter/header boundaries, collapsed spaces, unmatched strikethrough/math delimiters and terminal WWW slashes. All complete initialized callback streams are regenerated by the unchanged pinned md4c0.5.3 source after exact archive/member verification. Existing full callback and block-consumer suites replay the same cases. Diagnostic selection only read per-call Istanbul deltas; temporary diagnostics were removed and no source state, coverage counter, exclusion or threshold was changed. Current6 suites1848 tests pass; exact-map before/after comparison closes11 statements and19 branch arms. Remaining full100 coverage and ABI/resource-failure claims are not certified. B8TCAE producer audit:  M09 excludes only the unused nullish title fallback because every resolved ordinary link stores a real title array; M11 excludes only the impossible non-NORMAL alternative after the other three assigned text types were handled. Exact token/map proof retains every statement/function and other alternative. The separate permissive-autolink closer guard remains counted and unapplied: the original C comment explicitly addresses out-of-order marks, and63000 public diagnostic inputs without a hit do not prove unreachability. The complete8-suite/2017-test parser run passes all assertions; six-owner statements/lines/functions are100%, while two unresolved alternatives keep the combined branch gate failing. Runtime algorithms, original C source, input discovery and100% thresholds remain unchanged; full callback-detail/Writer model/ABI equivalence is not claimed.
